name: Image Mouse Trail
description: Cursor trail that spawns a rotated image at the pointer as the mouse moves, cycling through a list of images that pop in with a springy scale and then shrink away.
contents: Fixed pointer-transparent layer that holds the spawned trail images
Hidden source images used as clone templates
behavior: Spawns the next image at the cursor once it moved past a distance threshold and a minimum delay
Each image scales in with a random rotation, then scales out after a delay and is removed
Optional fade on entrance and exit
editableByProps: Entrance and exit timing, easing and fades

needsCodeEdit.where: mouseMoveHandler and the document mousemove listener

fixed: Listens to mousemove on document while mounted and removes it on unmount
Layer is fixed over the whole viewport and ignores pointer events
Mouse only, there is no trail on touch devices
